_comment: Ground-truth subject map for scoring an AI kit review of Contra stage 1 (scripts/artist_ai_review.py truth --subjects). Each key is a subject; each value lists the files a hand-made reference HD pack gives that subject. Only the reference pack's hires.txt is read - its PNGs are never opened, copied or sent anywhere. Files left out on purpose: Chr_N.png and WIP*.png are whole-pattern-page replacements that cover every tile in the game and so name nothing, and magenta.png is a debug fill.
